query: Which OAIS-aligned preservation formats and metadata profiles (e.g., METS + PREMIS) are optimal for audio, images, and documents from community archives?

response.query: Which OAIS-aligned preservation formats and metadata profiles (e.g., METS + PREMIS) are optimal for audio, images, and documents from community archives?
response.answer: For OAIS-aligned preservation, METS and PREMIS are optimal for metadata. Preferred formats are WAV for audio, TIFF/PNG for images, and PDF/A for documents. These formats ensure long-term accessibility and integrity.

results.title: The OAIS Reference Model: current implementations - DigiPres.org
results.content: # The OAIS Reference Model: current implementations. ## Abstract. The OAIS Reference Model (ISO 14721:2003) is an important part of the current digital preservation landscape. Initially developed by the Consultative Committee on Space Data Systems, the OAIS establishes a common framework of terms and concepts, identifies the basic functions of an archival system, and provides an information model for managing digital objects and information packages. The OAIS information model has proved to be extremely influential on the development of preservation metadata schemas. While the OAIS Reference Model does NOT specify any implementation, it has informed the implementation of some preservation systems, including the National Library of the Netherlands deposit system. This presentation will provide an introduction to the OAIS Reference Model and highlight some recent implementations that have been informed by it. ## Details. :   CC BY-SA 3.0 AT.

results.title: WDPD - Digital Preservation Coalition
results.content: This year I am privileged to be spending World Digital Preservation Day in the remarkable company of the National Library and Archives of New Zealand, host to the iPRES conference 2025. The team at Special Collections and University Archives have made major efforts to address digital preservation needs within the libraries and have expanded the level of support we can offer to Middle Tennessee community groups. ‘Digital Preservation: A Concerted Effort’ is the theme of this year’s World Digital Preservation Day, celebrating how, by working with colleagues at our university and beyond, digital preservation allows us to both share and gain knowledge, which in turn supports our efforts at digitally preserving our digital records. The resource I’m going to talk about isn’t exactly a ‘new’ resource, it was originally published%20back%20in%20August%20[https://archives.wales/records-at-risk/digital-preservation-for-small-businesses-an-introductory-guide/],%20but%20they%20generously%20agreed%20that%20the%20work%20could%20be%20repackaged%20and%20re-released%20on%20the%20DPC%20website%20to%20ensure%20that%20a%20wider%20and%20more%20international%20audience%20could%20also%20benefit%20from%20it.%20%20Why%20am%20I%20so%20excited%20to%20get%20this%20particular%20resource%20out%20on%20World%20Digital%20Preservation%20Day?%20The%20theme%20of%20World%20Digital%20Preservation%20Day%20this%20year%20is%20particularly%20inclusive%20-%20%20‘Data%20For%20All,%20For%20Good,%20Forever’.%20Much%20of%20the%20work%20that%20I%20do%20at%20the%20DPC%20tends%20to%20have%20a%20focus%20on%20working%20with%20people%20who%20are%20already%20part%20of%20our%20community,%20and%20are%20already%20sold%20on%20the%20idea%20that%20digital%20preservation%20is%20‘A%20Good%20Thing’.%20This%20is%20all%20good,%20but%20sometimes%20I%20am%20aware%20of%20the%20echo%20chamber%20within%20which%20I%20tend%20to%20reside.%20Wouldn’t%20it%20be%20good%20on%20World%20Digital%20Preservation%20Day%20to%20get%20the%20message%20out%20to%20new%20audiences%20and%20perhaps%20even%20reach%20someone%20who%20has%20not%20considered%20digital%20preservation%20before?%20What%20better%20way%20to%20‘Let%20Digits%20Flourish’%20than%20to%20encourage%20someone%20to%20take%20the%20very%20first%20steps%20to%20preserving%20their%20business%20records…?%20%20Earlier%20this%20year,%20the%20DPC%20was%20approached%20by%20ARCW%20and%20asked%20if%20we%20could%20work%20with%20them%20on%20the%20production%20of%20an%20introductory%20guide%20to%20digital%20preservation%20aimed%20at%20small%20businesses%20in%20Wales.%20Survey%20work%20carried%20out%20as%20part%20of%20their%20‘Records%20at%20Risk’%20project%20[https://archives.wales/records-at-risk/]%20had%20highlighted%20a%20gap%20in%20the%20literature%20and%20a%20very%20real%20need%20from%20the%20community%20for%20a%20simple%20guide%20to%20explain%20how%20to%20begin%20to%20tackle%20the%20challenge%20of%20digital%20preservation.%20We%20were%20keen%20to%20work%20with%20them%20on%20this%20and%20produce%20some%20guidance%20for%20this%20community,%20but%20also%20immediately%20saw%20an%20opportunity%20to%20create%20something%20more%20generic%20that%20could%20be%20used%20internationally.%20This%20particular%20challenge%20is%20not%20easily%20contained%20by%20geographic%20boundaries!%20%20So%20whilst%20ARCW%20released%20the%20original%20version%20of%20the%20guide%20(including%20Welsh%20translation%20[https://archifau.cymru/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Digital-Preservation-for-Small-Businesses-Cymraeg.docx.pdf])%20in%20the%20summer,%20we%20have%20made%20some%20very%20minor%20revisions%20to%20it%20and%20are%20now%20able%20to%20release%20a%20version%20for%20an%20international%20audience.%20%20Digital%20Preservation%20for%20Small%20Businesses:%20An%20introductory%20guide%20[link]%20%20[Screenshot]%20%20ARCW%20provided%20a%20clear%20brief%20for%20this%20piece%20of%20work%20%20including%20a%20list%20of%20topics%20to%20cover,%20suggested%20structure%20and%20an%20indication%20of%20length%20(short!)%20and%20tone%20(introductory!).%20Our%20chats%20with%20them%20to%20guide%20the%20creation%20of%20this%20resource%20were%20incredibly%20helpful%20and%20in%20particular%20their%20examples%20of%20the%20target%20audience%20of%20the%20guide,%20as%20revealed%20through%20their%20survey%20work,%20helped%20to%20focus%20the%20mind.%20I%20found%20myself%20continually%20coming%20back%20to%20the%20idea%20of%20a%20100%20year%20old%20shoe%20shop%20in%20Wales%20-%20a%20long%20standing%20family%20business%20(with%20no%20IT%20or%20records%20management%20department)%20and%20a%20clear%20need%20to%20manage%20its%20physical%20and%20digital%20records%20for%20as%20long%20as%20necessary.%20This%20case%20study%20helped%20to%20frame%20the%20content%20and%20tone%20of%20the%20guide%20as%20it%20was%20being%20created.%20%20In%20working%20on%20this%20guide,%20it%20quickly%20dawned%20on%20me%20that%20its%20main%20focus%20must%20actually%20be%20on%20good%20day-to-day%20records%20management%20practices.%20Though%20purists%20may%20say%20this%20isn’t%20exactly%20‘digital%20preservation’,%20we%20all%20know%20that%20one%20of%20the%20keys%20to%20successful%20digital%20preservation%20is%20to%20manage%20digital%20information%20well%20from%20the%20very%20point%20of%20creation.%20Keeping%20the%20guide%20realistic%20around%20what%20a%20small%20business%20may%20and%20may%20not%20be%20able%20to%20do%20was%20important.%20The%20priority%20was%20around%20managing%20common%20and%20immediate%20risks%20to%20digital%20content%20and%20thus%20increasing%20the%20likelihood%20that%20the%20content%20would%20be%20available%20for%20the%20next%20generation.%20It%20may%20be%20unrealistic%20to%20expect%20a%20small%20business%20to%20establish%20their%20own%20digital%20archive,%20but%20perhaps%20more%20appropriate%20to%20direct%20them%20to%20web%20archiving%20services%20or%20encourage%20them%20to%20consider%20talking%20to%20their%20local%20archive%20to%20discuss%20the%20longer%20term%20preservation%20of%20their%20digital%20(and%20indeed%20physical)%20records.%20The%20tips%20within%20the%20guide%20focus%20on%20small%20practical%20actions%20that%20will%20help%20ensure%20the%20records%20are%20well%20looked%20after%20in%20the%20meantime.%20%20So,%20the%20guide%20is%20out%20there%20and%20will%20sit%20alongside%20the%20other%20resources%20and%20publications%20on%20the%20DPC%20website.%20I%20feel%20like%20our%20main%20challenge%20now%20is%20getting%20it%20out%20to%20the%20right%20audience.%20If%20you%20know%20small%20businesses%20who%20might%20find%20this%20guide%20helpful,%20please%20do%20share%20the%20link%20[link]%20and%20help%20us%20to%20get%20the%20word%20out%20there.%20What%20better%20day%20to%20do%20this%20than%20World%20Digital%20Preservation%20Day!%20%20Let%20business%20records%20flourish!%20%20My%20thanks%20go%20to%20ARCW%20(particularly%20Gemma%20Evans%20and%20Sally%20McInnes%20at%20the%20National%20Library%20of%20Wales)%20for%20the%20opportunity%20to%20produce%20this%20guidance%20and%20to%20The%20National%20Archives%20(UK)%20for%20supporting%20this%20work%20through%20the%20Covid-19%20Archives%20Fund.) and promoted by the Archives and Records Council Wales (ARCW) back in August, but they generously agreed that the work could be repackaged and re-released on the DPC website to ensure that a wider and more international audience could also benefit from it.
